test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the Telaiya dam located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Telaiya Dam is situated in Jharkhand.
 
• It is the first Dam and hydro -Electric power station constructed by Damodar Valley Corporation across the Barakar River, in the Koderma district.
 
• The dam is 1200 ft long and 99 ft high situated in an ideal surrounding with a beautiful reservoir in a 36 sq km area.
 
• The dam was built with the main object of controlling floods, the hydroelectric station produces 4MW.
 
• Tilaiya Dam was the first of the four multi-purpose dams included in the first phase of the Damodar Valley Corporation and it opened on 21 February 1953.
